_how: YouTube links on the blog. channel: your channel's address (for example https://www.youtube.com/@nmxlabs); leave empty and the site fills it in by itself once your channel is connected. queries: what each post's "Watch on YouTube" tile searches for when no video in content/videos.json matches the post (slug: search words).
